President Donald Trump gave over $150,000 in cash to four White House aides, with the payments categorized as “cash gifts for the holidays” in the staffers’ latest financial disclosure forms filed by the Trump administration.

Trump paid assistant Natalie Harp, communications adviser Margo Martin, and deputy director of Oval Office operations Chamberlain Harris cash gifts of $45,000 each. Trump also gave Walt Nauta, his director of Oval Office operations, a $20,000 gift for the holidays. The payments were first reported by the Washington Post.
